snippet.title: MarchMallows (co-op puzzle party game) | Cozy Chaos #puzzlegames #partygames #coopgaming #indiegame
snippet.description:
Guide a bunch of adorable, clueless Marchies safely home in this chaotic co-op and PvP puzzle game. Place tools and objects to clear their path, solve deadly obstacles, and keep them alive. Get them all home and pat your friends on the back, or watch them die and start pointing fingers at each other

Play partygames and beat your friends inbetween the saving. Or maybe just skip the saving part and beat your friends instead.

Wishlist MarchMallows on Steam to support the developer and stay updated.
